title: spec: an object declares the business order of its related lists — `relatedLists: ['task', 'event', …]`, an ordered list of child relationships like `highlightFields` is of fields; unlisted ones follow the derived order; a name that matches no inbound relationship is refused
body:
Part of the record-page-v3 epic #26676 (v3 child 9). Contract card (spec lane), `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER before the queue.

## Source (origin/main `7bb8084590`)

The order of a record page's related lists is not authorable: `deriveRelatedLists.ts:262-328` buckets `master_detail` children before `lookup` children and, inside each bucket, follows the object registry's order (package declaration / served order); `buildDefaultTabs` (`buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:1003-1012`, ADR-0085 rule Z) only promotes `relatedList: 'primary'` lists ahead of the rest. HotCRM declares no `primary`, so a lead's related column is 「owned children in declaration order, then lookup children in declaration order」 — an order nobody chose. The maintainer's ruling (2026-10-28), verbatim: on the question 「元数据的开发者，可以根据业务的重要性自己指定顺序吗」 with options A (an ordered list on the parent object) / B (a number on each child FK) / C (full page only): 「A」.

## Target

1. `ObjectSchema` gains `relatedLists?: string[]` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, beside `highlightFields`): an ordered list of inbound relationships, each entry a child object name (`'task'`) or `object.field` when the child has more than one FK to this object (`'event.related_to'`); describe() says it orders the related lists of the record page by business importance; strict names: an entry that matches no inbound `lookup` / `master_detail` field of the object is refused at `defineStack` with the ADR-0112 envelope naming the entry and the inbound relationships that exist (a cross-object check at compose time, where the registry is known — measure where `highlightFields`' field-existence check runs and sit beside it).
2. Resolution (one pure function in `deriveRelatedLists.ts`, replacing the registry-order tail): listed relationships first in the declared order; unlisted ones after, in today's derived order (owned → lookup, declaration order). `relatedList: 'primary'` no longer orders; its meaning becomes PLACEMENT — a `primary` list is drawn in the record's body as a full-width table (the details column, after the field sections), not as a side card; a `master_detail` FK with `inlineEdit` is `primary` by default (maintainer, 2026-10-28, on a quote's line items: 「明细行的子表放在右侧合适嘛？」 → the body). `relatedLists` orders the body tables among themselves and the side cards among themselves. The describe() of `relatedList` says so; the objectstack-ui skill bullet follows.
   Placement of a body table among the field groups (maintainer, 2026-10-28: 「他如果做到放在基本信息下面，而条款和备注在后面」「如果有多个子表呢」): `ObjectFieldGroupSchema` gains an optional `relatedList?: string` (same naming as `relatedLists` entries — child object, or `object.field`) so a group entry can stand for a body table instead of fields: `{ name: 'lines', label: '报价明细', relatedList: 'crm_quote_line_item.crm_quote' }` places that table at that position in the details column; a group with `relatedList` carries no `fields` and no field may name it as its `group` (refused). Body tables not placed this way follow the default rule (#27055: stacked after the first field group, in `relatedLists` order). Studio's field-group designer draws such an entry as a draggable row (#27054). `relatedList: false` still hides regardless of the list.
3. The reader's drag order (#27055 / #27052) overrides this per user; 「恢复默认顺序」 returns to it.
4. Liveness: the key has a consumer in the same PR (the console's record page), so the ledger row is `live`, not `planned`; `check:authorable-surface` baseline regenerated; the objectstack-data skill's object rules gain one bullet (governed `skills/**` → Tier H).
5. HotCRM is not changed here; a follow-up on hotcrm declares the order for lead / opportunity / account once the spec ships.

## File surface

`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (+ form `object.form.ts` row for Studio), the authorable-surface baseline, liveness ledger, spec tests; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts` + tests; `skills/objectstack-data/rules/*.md` (one bullet); changesets (`@objectstack/spec` minor, `added`).

## Acceptance

1. `safeParse` accepts `relatedLists: ['task', 'event.related_to']`; `defineStack` refuses `relatedLists: ['nope']` with `code` + `status` and a message naming `nope` and the inbound relationships; a non-array / non-string entry fails the shape.
2. A lead with `relatedLists: ['task', 'campaign_member']` renders tasks, campaign members, then the rest in the derived order; `primary` still promotes an unlisted list.
3. Studio control is #27054's; the layout card #27055 reads the resolved order.

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>
